correctness.rationale: For every 0<=c<=1 the geometric sum has two positive real denominators and is affine in exp(i phi). For sin phi not zero, simultaneous vanishing of real/imaginary components forces x=0 or x=1/2; at phi=pi the factor v-w yields precisely the interior pair. Exact monotonic rational ratios in cos phi give both pairs and endpoints. The attached checker matches direct sums at 420 points and all predicted test zeros; it is supplementary, not the proof.

value.rationale: The result gives a complete exact phase diagram of a natural nonnegative yet bimodal window with three algebraically distinct zero mechanisms and repeated 1-to-5 transitions. Zak-zero geometry is a necessary component of Gabor-frame analysis; the unexpected five-zero phases establish a substantive structural boundary beyond the one-zero positive-unimodal/TP regimes. No unsupported frame set classification is claimed.
